title: Ikholwa Elifihliweyo
intro: Kwiiholo zamandla ezidumileyo, apho ukungakholwa nogonyamelo kwakulawula khona, ilizwi elilodwa lenyaniso lathetha livela kwindawo engalindelekanga. Lo mntu wacela umngeni kwigunya lokukhusela isithunywa, ebeka ukhuseleko lwaso emngciphekweni ukuze sivakalise inyaniso.
clues: Ndandihlala kwilizwe elinobundlongondlongo obukhulu, ndikhonza umlawuli owayesithi ndinguThixo.
Ndazifihla iinkolelo zam zokwenyani kangangeminyaka emininzi, ndisoyika imiphumo yokuzityhila.
Xa kufika umthunywa onemiqondiso ecacileyo, ndakholwa, kodwa abantu bam baceba ukumchasa.
Ndema phambi komlawuli okhohlakeleyo kunye nebhunga lakhe, ndisithi akufanele babulale umthunywa ongenatyala.
Ndabalumkisa ngesohlwayo seentlanga zangaphambili ezazingayamkeli inyaniso, njengabantu bakaNowa no-'Ad.
U-Allah wandisindisa kwiindlela zabo ezimbi, ndaza ndabona ukutshatyalaliswa kolawulo olucinezelayo.
arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
